final: SELECT f.film_id, f.rating, COUNT(i.inventory_id) AS copies, COUNT(i.inventory_id) - (SELECT AVG(copy_count) FROM (SELECT COUNT(i2.inventory_id) AS copy_count FROM film f2 LEFT JOIN inventory i2 ON i2.film_id = f2.film_id WHERE f2.rating = f.rating GROUP BY f2.film_id)) AS difference_from_rating_average, COUNT(i.inventory_id) - (SELECT AVG(copy_count) FROM (SELECT COUNT(i3.inventory_id) AS copy_count FROM film f3 LEFT JOIN inventory i3 ON i3.film_id = f3.film_id GROUP BY f3.film_id)) AS difference_from_overall_average FROM film f LEFT JOIN inventory i ON i.film_id = f.film_id GROUP BY f.film_id, f.rating ORDER BY difference_from_overall_average DESC LIMIT 10
